narrative.overview:
Mars Bank has two deliberate, current visual worlds. Public and login surfaces retain the Orbital Registry: a dark graphite coordinate sheet or light dust paper, condensed Saira typography, ruled cells, and survey-like precision. Authenticated routes under `/banking` use the Search-led Account Desk: a light operational workspace with graphite chrome, white ledger sheets, Hanken Grotesk, and restrained rounded geometry.

These are not themes of one surface and the desk does not replace the public identity. The shared brand constants are the orbital-arc lockup, oxide action color, and signal blue. The route boundary is the authority: public styles inherit root theme tokens; authenticated desk tokens are scoped to `.banking-shell` and stay light in both themes.
keyCharacteristics: Two route-bound worlds: expressive Orbital Registry in public, quiet Account Desk after sign-in
Orbital lockup, oxide, and signal blue connect both worlds
Public uses graphite/dust, condensed Saira, sharp survey rules; desk uses cool neutral sheets, Hanken Grotesk, 6px cards, and 3px controls
Signal communicates financial availability; oxide communicates action
Both worlds avoid game-like sci-fi decoration and preserve premium-bank credibility

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: Public pages may switch between graphite and dust. Every authenticated desk stays on its light canvas in both themes while its top bar, rail, and mobile tabs stay graphite.

rules.name: The Spendable Signal Rule
rules.body: In the desk, signal blue marks money the customer can spend or positive posted movement. Loan debt, credit owed, original principal, and credit limits remain desk ink.

rules.name: The Action Oxide Rule
rules.body: Oxide means the primary action and the active rail edge. Do not turn it into a general surface fill.

rules.name: The Route Type Rule
rules.body: Saira Extra Condensed gives public pages their registry voice; Hanken Grotesk gives authenticated work its desk voice. Do not carry public all-caps display typography into `/banking`.

rules.name: The Reserved Uppercase Rule
rules.body: In the desk, tracked uppercase belongs only to structural labels: column headers, metric labels, totals labels, and restated row words.

rules.name: The Shared Column Rule
rules.body: Every visible account uses one common ledger grid. If a product changes the meaning of a shared column, keep the grid and restate the row's words.

rules.name: The Reconciled Total Rule
rules.body: The headline available total and ledger totals row are computed from the same spendable set and must match. Deposit balance excludes unused credit; loans count toward neither figure.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Separate desk content with tone and rules, not elevation. Shadows remain reserved for depicted physical objects.

rules.name: The One Settle Rule
rules.body: Desk cards may perform the single arrival settle in reading order. Do not add looping, decorative, or competing motion.

dos: Do choose the world by route: Orbital Registry for public/login, Search-led Account Desk for `/banking`.
Do preserve the orbital lockup, oxide, and signal as cross-world brand constants.
Do keep every authenticated canvas light in both themes and every authenticated chrome region graphite.
Do use signal only for spendable or positive movement semantics in the desk.
Do restate product-specific column meanings without breaking the shared ledger.
Do keep the Demo data chip visible on every authenticated view.
Do keep the headline and ledger available totals reconciled from the same account set.
donts: Don't present the Account Desk as a replacement for the public Orbital Registry.
Don't carry condensed all-caps registry typography into authenticated daily work.
Don't color loan debt, credit owed, original principal, or limits signal blue.
Don't use sci-fi HUD glow, planet globes, or game chrome.
Don't add kickers or eyebrows above headlines.
Don't use shadows to lift desk ledger cards.
Don't round public registry containers or square off desk cards to force one world onto the other.
